Weekly Live Guidance Sessions

A live session every week: one topic, one time slot, one join link. Past sessions stay here with their summary, the questions that were discussed and the doubts students raised.

Quick answer

Every session lists its topic, date, time and platform with a direct join link, then keeps a summary, the important questions discussed and the student doubts raised. Upcoming sessions appear first and past sessions stay below them, so nothing you attended disappears.
